sentences.l2: 弟は英語の単語を覚えるのが苦手だった。
sentences.l1: My younger brother was bad at memorizing English words.

sentences.l2: しかし、最近スマートフォンの単語ゲームで遊ぶようになってから、少しずつ覚えられるようになった。
sentences.l1: However, since he started playing a word game on his smartphone recently, he has become able to memorize them little by little.

sentences.l2: ゲームでは、正しく答えるとバッジがもらえるので、楽しく続けられるらしい。
sentences.l1: In the game, he gets a badge when he answers correctly, so apparently he can keep going happily.

sentences.l2: 毎日十分ほどだが、繰り返すうちに言葉に慣れ、記憶にも残りやすくなったという。
sentences.l1: It is only about ten minutes every day, but they say that as he repeated it, he got used to the words and they also became easier to remember.

sentences.l2: ただ遊ぶだけでなく、適切な刺激があると、勉強の効率は大きく変わるのだ。
sentences.l1: It is not just playing; with appropriate stimulation, the efficiency of studying changes greatly.
